# SOP-P3-L1-04 Shift handover - Hot Forge line
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Outgoing operator confirms line in stable state and communicates active work orders.  
   1.2. Verify that coil cooling water flow meets required cooling for EQ-P3-L1-IH03: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min.  
   1.3. Verify that visible hardware fasteners on hydraulic forging press are intact: The main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m.  
   1.4. Check status of scrap bin and conveyor on EQ-P3-L1-SB02; report blockages to maintenance per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.

2. Handover procedure
   2.1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator on:
       - Current job, material heat numbers, special handling notes.
       - Any active alarms, faults, or interlocks on EQ-P3-L1-IH03 and EQ-P3-L1-HP01.
       - Recent maintenance actions referenced in MM-P3-L1-IH03 and MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.
   2.2. Demonstrate control panel indicators and emergency stop locations for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 and EQ-P3-L1-IH03.
   2.3. Incoming operator performs independent walkdown, confirms preconditions in section 1, and signs the log.

3. Communication and escalation
   3.1. If coil cooling water flow is below the stated minimum, take the line to safe stop and notify maintenance per MM-P3-L1-IH03.
   3.2. If the main ram bolt torque is unknown or suspected incorrect, secure line and escalate to maintenance per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and hold production per SOP-P3-L1-02.

4. PPE
   4.1. Required PPE for both outgoing and incoming operator: hearing protection, face shield, heat-resistant gloves, welding apron, safety boots, and high-visibility clothing.

5. Sign-off
   5.1. Both outgoing and incoming operators print name, sign, and time on shift handover log.  
   5.2. Supervisor verifies handover completeness and initials the log.  
   5.3. Archive completed handover log per document control and reference SOP-P3-L1-02.
